title: Mouse and Mouser
author: Joseph Jacobs
summary: 老鼠与猫的一问一答，唱出猫步步逼近、最终扑向老鼠的过程。
publicDomainBasis: Published 1892; collected by Joseph Jacobs (1854–1916). Public domain in the United States and in China (author's life plus 70 years).

paragraphs.en: The Mouse went to visit the Cat, and found her sitting behind the hall door, spinning.
paragraphs.zh: 老鼠去拜访猫，看见她正坐在大厅门后纺线。

paragraphs.en: MOUSE. What are you doing, my lady, my lady, What are you doing, my lady?
paragraphs.zh: 老鼠：您在做什么呀，我的夫人，我的夫人，您在做什么呀，我的夫人？

paragraphs.en: CAT (sharply). I'm spinning old breeches, good body, good body I'm spinning old breeches, good body.
paragraphs.zh: 猫（尖声地）：我在纺旧裤子呢，好家伙，好家伙，我在纺旧裤子呢，好家伙。

paragraphs.en: MOUSE. Long may you wear them, my lady, my lady, Long may you wear them, my lady.
paragraphs.zh: 老鼠：愿您穿得长久，我的夫人，我的夫人，愿您穿得长久，我的夫人。

paragraphs.en: CAT (gruffly). I'll wear' em and tear 'em, good body, good body. I'll wear 'em and tear 'em, good body.
paragraphs.zh: 猫（粗声粗气地）：我要把它们穿破、撕烂，好家伙，好家伙。我要把它们穿破、撕烂，好家伙。

paragraphs.en: MOUSE. I was sweeping my room, my lady, my lady, I was sweeping my room, my lady.
paragraphs.zh: 老鼠：我在打扫房间呢，我的夫人，我的夫人，我在打扫房间呢，我的夫人。

paragraphs.en: CAT. The cleaner you'd be, good body, good body, The cleaner you'd be, good body.
paragraphs.zh: 猫：那你会更干净，好家伙，好家伙，那你会更干净，好家伙。

paragraphs.en: MOUSE. I found a silver sixpence, my lady, my lady, I found a silver sixpence, my lady.
paragraphs.zh: 老鼠：我捡到一枚银六便士，我的夫人，我的夫人，我捡到一枚银六便士，我的夫人。

paragraphs.en: CAT. The richer you were, good body, good body, The richer you were, good body.
paragraphs.zh: 猫：那你会更富有，好家伙，好家伙，那你会更富有，好家伙。

paragraphs.en: MOUSE. I went to the market, my lady, my lady, I went to the market, my lady.
paragraphs.zh: 老鼠：我去了一趟集市，我的夫人，我的夫人，我去了一趟集市，我的夫人。

paragraphs.en: CAT. The further you went, good body, good body The further you went, good body.
paragraphs.zh: 猫：那你走得更远，好家伙，好家伙，那你走得更远，好家伙。

paragraphs.en: MOUSE. I bought me a pudding, my lady, my lady, I bought me a pudding, my lady.
paragraphs.zh: 老鼠：我给自己买了一个布丁，我的夫人，我的夫人，我给自己买了一个布丁，我的夫人。

paragraphs.en: CAT (snarling). The more meat you had, good body, good body, The more meat you had, good body.
paragraphs.zh: 猫（咆哮着）：那你肉吃得更多，好家伙，好家伙，那你肉吃得更多，好家伙。

paragraphs.en: MOUSE. I put it in the window to cool, my lady, I put it in the window to cool.
paragraphs.zh: 老鼠：我把它放在窗台上晾凉，我的夫人，我把它放在窗台上晾凉。

paragraphs.en: CAT. (sharply). The faster you'd eat it, good body, good body, The faster you'd eat it, good body.
paragraphs.zh: 猫（尖声地）：那你会吃得更快，好家伙，好家伙，那你会吃得更快，好家伙。

paragraphs.en: MOUSE (timidly). The cat came and ate it, my lady, my lady, The cat came and ate it, my lady.
paragraphs.zh: 老鼠（怯生生地）：猫过来把它吃掉了，我的夫人，我的夫人，猫过来把它吃掉了，我的夫人。

paragraphs.en: CAT (pouncingly). And I'll eat you, good body, good body, And I'll eat you, good body.
paragraphs.zh: 猫（扑上去）：那我还要吃掉你，好家伙，好家伙，那我还要吃掉你，好家伙。

paragraphs.en: (Springs upon the mouse and kills it.)
